text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: After considering the track conditions of the Prix Jacques Le Marois, Trainer concludes that beating Taiki there is unrealistic.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I feel a strong connection between Taiki and the Prix Jacques Le Marois, so I come to the same conclusion. There's just no way I can win.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But we find another route forward! We may have to give up being the first to win a European G1, but we can simply overtake Taiki in the future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The first step to accomplishing that is to challenge Taiki at the Sprinters Stakes after she returns to Japan!
